scripts.setup: sh -c 'pnpm install && (node -e "require(\"better-sqlite3\")" 2>/dev/null || (cd node_modules/better-sqlite3 && npx --yes prebuild-install 2>/dev/null || pnpm rebuild better-sqlite3 2>/dev/null || true)) && [ -f "$CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH/.env.local" ] && cp "$CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH/.env.local" .env.local || true; [ -d "$CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH/.planning" ] && { [ -L .planning ] || rm -rf .planning; ln -sf "$CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH/.planning" .planning; } || true; mkdir -p "$CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH/.data" && [ ! -e .data ] && ln -s "$CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH/.data" .data || true; node -e "var fs=require(\"fs\"),p=require(\"path\"),f=\".claude/settings.json\",s={};try{s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,\"utf8\"))}catch{}s.env=Object.assign(s.env||{},{CLAUDE_CODE_TASK_LIST_ID:process.env.CONDUCTOR_WORKSPACE_NAME||\"default\",CLAUDE_MEM_PROJECT:p.basename(process.env.CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH||process.cwd())});fs.writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify(s,null,2)+\"\\n\")"'
scripts.run: sh -c 'supabase status >/dev/null 2>&1 || supabase start && export BETTER_AUTH_URL=http://localhost:$CONDUCTOR_PORT NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:$CONDUCTOR_PORT && pnpm dev --port $CONDUCTOR_PORT'
